https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: Roost.ai provides users with an automated environment orchestration platform for rapid deployment and testing of applications, enabling efficient software development workflows.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create, manage, and delete automated environments for application testing.
Users must be able to integrate version control systems (e.g., Git) to synchronize codebase changes with the environments.
Users must be able to trigger environment creation based on specific events, such as code commits or pipeline executions.
Users must have the ability to monitor the status and resource utilization of active environments in real-time.
Users must be able to access and interact with application environments via browser-based interfaces or terminal commands.
Administrators must be able to configure role-based access control to manage permissions for team members.
Users must be able to schedule environment deployments for specific times to optimize resource usage and testing workflows.
